scope: Additional safe classroom experiment concepts only.

experiments.title: Flour in water
experiments.focus: Show that some powders make cloudy mixtures instead of clear solutions.
student_observations: The powder does not disappear completely.
Not every solid dissolves in water.

experiments.title: Cornstarch thick mixture
experiments.focus: Show how a powder can make a thick suspension instead of a clear solution.
student_observations: The liquid does not stay perfectly clear.
experiments.teacher_note: Use this to discuss suspensions and viscosity.

experiments.title: Gelatin texture
experiments.focus: Introduce how some mixtures become thicker or more structured.
student_observations: The model can look and feel thicker.
Mixtures can have very different physical properties.
experiments.teacher_note: Keep the example conceptual and classroom-level.

experiments.title: Oatmeal mixture
experiments.focus: Show how a familiar food mixture behaves in water.
student_observations: The mixture is not a clear solution.
experiments.teacher_note: A simple real-world connection for students.

experiments.title: Mixture review 2
experiments.focus: Review the difference between a clear solution and several kinds of mixtures.
student_observations: Some materials make the mixture thicker.
experiments.teacher_note: Useful for a final review or classroom quiz.
